description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the (Direct Assessment : Pairwise Ranking) Merging Ratio on the x-axis and two performance metrics on the dual y-axes: Direct Assessment Pearson Correlation (left, linear scale from 0.500 to 0.675) and Pairwise Ranking Agreement Accuracy (right, linear scale from 50 to 75). The x-axis spans merging ratios from 1:9 to 9:1, with tick marks at 1:9, 2:8, 3:7, 4:6, 5:5, 6:4, 7:3, 8:2, and 9:1. Three lines are plotted: the green line with circle markers (Direct Assessment Correlation) starts at approximately 0.500 at 1:9, rises steadily to a peak of ~0.670 at 5:5, then declines to ~0.600 at 9:1; the blue line with circle markers (Pairwise Ranking Accuracy) begins near 0.660 at 1:9, peaks slightly above 0.665 around 3:7, then drops sharply to ~0.500 at 9:1; the black line with square markers (Average Performance) starts at ~0.578 at 1:9, increases gradually to a peak of ~0.625 at 5:5, then decreases to ~0.525 at 9:1. All lines show a general trend of peaking near the 5:5 ratio before declining as the merging ratio becomes more skewed toward pairwise ranking.
